name: Varirata National Park and the Owen Stanley foothills
story: Varirata National Park and the Owen Stanley foothills are located in Papua New Guinea. This forest area is home to wildlife including the Raggiana bird-of-paradise, hooded pitohui, and spectacled flying fox.
matters: The park provides a habitat for forest species such as the Raggiana bird-of-paradise, which is an important seed disperser of fruiting trees in New Guinea.
